events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks the annual global celebration of the James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: Bond's enduring appeal
angles.copy: From Connery to Craig, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

angles.name: Freddie's enduring spirit
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.
